children: In his new role, Nirwan will have end-to-end ownership of Envalior’s brand and communications strategy across India, the Middle East and Africa

Envalior, a global materials company specialising in high-performance engineering materials, has appointed Aniket Nirwan as Regional Communications Manager, IMEA, covering India, the Middle East and Africa.

In the new role, Nirwan will take end-to-end ownership of Envalior’s regional communications and brand strategy, serving as the link between the company’s global brand function and regional business leadership.

His mandate spans the planning and execution of the region’s communications and brand agenda. He will also be responsible for building relationships with media, industry stakeholders and partners across IMEA, adapting global messaging to individual market contexts and tracking regional performance to inform ongoing strategy.
Nirwan brings nearly a decade of experience across B2B and B2C sectors, with expertise spanning regional communications, brand strategy, channel marketing and partner engagement.

He joins Envalior from Sandvik Coromant, where he served as Channel Marketing Specialist and led pan-India channel marketing initiatives. His previous marketing roles include stints at Tata BlueScope Steel and Thermax.

Nileshkumar Kukalyekar, Business Director, South Asia, Middle East & Africa, Envalior, says, “Having one person own the region's brand narrative end to end is increasingly important as we grow across IMEA. Aniket's experience, combined with the full ownership this role demands, will help translate our business priorities into stronger engagement across such a diverse set of markets.”

Commenting on his appointment, Aniket Nirwan, Regional Communications Manager, IMEA, Envalior, says, “I am excited to join Envalior at a time when industries across IMEA are undergoing rapid transformation driven by innovation, sustainability and evolving customer expectations. Marketing today goes far beyond communications.

It is about building a strong brand, shaping reputation, creating meaningful customer connections and driving business growth. My vision is to strengthen Envalior’s presence across the region by bringing together strategic communications, brand leadership, stakeholder engagement and market-focused storytelling. By connecting our global purpose and expertise with the realities of local markets, we have an opportunity to reinforce Envalior’s position as a trusted partner and industry leader while creating lasting value for customers, partners and communities across IMEA.”
With the appointment, Envalior is aligning its IMEA brand and communications agenda more closely with its global direction while maintaining a market-focused approach across the region.
